title: Twin-2K-500: A dataset for building digital twins of over 2,000 people based on their answers to over 500 questions

bias_targets.methodology: Replicating classic heuristics and biases experiments from behavioral economics and psychology (e.g., base rate fallacy, outcome bias, sunk cost fallacy, anchoring, framing, omission bias, myside bias) and comparing LLM-simulated digital twins' responses to actual human test-retest baselines.

Comparing the distribution of LLM digital twin policy preferences (e.g., support for increased deportations) against human population responses in a false consensus task to evaluate the model's ability to accurately reflect conservative viewpoints.
